title: VC4Tile M5 typed verification specification
notes: M5 is ergonomic VC4Tile only; no producer lowering and no executable sub-32 precision.
Hardware fixtures are candidate-first and fresh by default.

m5-00-milestone-package.title: M5 milestone package
m5-00-milestone-package.expected_end_state: M5 package files exist and parse; M5 mechanisms are registered; scope is locked.

required_literals: M5 does not implement executable sub-32 precision

m5-01-surface-core-pipeline-and-runner.title: Surface/core pipeline and VC4Tile candidate runner integration
m5-01-surface-core-pipeline-and-runner.expected_end_state: Add/register canonical M5 surface/core passes and integrate the VC4Tile candidate runner so ergonomic inputs flow through surface canonicalization, copy planning, core CFG legalization, core verification, VC4Tile-to-SSAVC4, SSAVC4-to-VC4, and bundle emission.

m5-02-tile-layout-types-and-precision-ma.title: Tile/layout types and 32-bit precision markers
m5-02-tile-layout-types-and-precision-ma.expected_end_state: Define tile/layout/role/precision vocabulary for ergonomic VC4Tile, with 32-bit-only executable semantics and strict diagnostics for sub-32 forms.

m5-03-vdr-vcd-global-to-vpm-load-support.title: SSAVC4 VDR/VCD global-to-VPM load support
m5-03-vdr-vcd-global-to-vpm-load-support.expected_end_state: Add lower-half SSAVC4 VDR/VCD global-to-VPM load support so the M5 copy planner can choose hardware-natural global-to-shared paths.

m5-04-copy-planner-v1.title: VC4Tile copy planner v1
m5-04-copy-planner-v1.expected_end_state: Implement the first VC4Tile copy planner and ergonomic movement ops for global/register/shared movement, views, subviews, transpose views, and shared tile allocation.

m5-05-global-register-tile-load-store.title: Global/register tile load-store ergonomics
m5-05-global-register-tile-load-store.expected_end_state: Prove ergonomic global/register tile load/store patterns with tail masks, 2D row-major indexing, and supported affine stride behavior on real hardware.

m5-06-shared-vpm-copy-and-transpose.title: Shared VPM copy and ergonomic transpose
m5-06-shared-vpm-copy-and-transpose.expected_end_state: Make shared VPM copy and shared transpose ergonomic while lowering to concrete VPM/VDR/VDW/barrier paths.

m5-07-scf-composition-with-ergonomic-ops.title: SCF composition with ergonomic tile ops
m5-07-scf-composition-with-ergonomic-ops.expected_end_state: Prove supported scf.for/scf.if composition with ergonomic tile ops; surface ops must plan first and SCF/index must disappear before SSAVC4 lowering.

m5-08-boundary-resource-role-metadata.title: Boundary, resource, and role metadata
m5-08-boundary-resource-role-metadata.expected_end_state: Add semantic metadata for roles, boundary policies, resource intent, copy stages, and reuse hints; consume, preserve, or reject every accepted field deterministically.

m5-09-elementwise-tile-compute.title: Elementwise tile compute
m5-09-elementwise-tile-compute.expected_end_state: Add ergonomic tile_fill/broadcast/add/sub/mul/select and optional fma, lower to concrete vector/scalar core arithmetic, and prove on hardware.

m5-10-tile-and-block-reductions.title: Tile and block reductions
m5-10-tile-and-block-reductions.expected_end_state: Add ergonomic tile/warp/block reductions that lower to existing rotate/reduce/shared/barrier mechanisms with input-dependent hardware proofs.

m5-11-tile-contract-dot-matmul.title: Tile contract, dot, and matmul
m5-11-tile-contract-dot-matmul.expected_end_state: Add tile_contract, tile_dot, and tile_matmul as future producer-facing ergonomic surface contracts and lower small 32-bit forms to movement, elementwise, and reduction operations.

m5-cute-stress-hardware-matrix.title: M5 CuTe-style stress hardware matrix
m5-cute-stress-hardware-matrix.expected_end_state: CuTe-style composed VC4Tile GEMM fixtures lower through the ergonomic VC4Tile pipeline and pass strict real-hardware CPU-reference checks.

m5-12-final-acceptance.title: M5 final acceptance
m5-12-final-acceptance.expected_end_state: M5 is complete, scoped, candidate-first, hardware-backed, and regression-clean.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import re,sys
roots=[Path("compiler/include"),Path("compiler/lib"),Path("compiler/tools"),Path("compiler/test/CodeGen/VC4Tile/Support")]
checks=[("direct",r"convert-vc4tile-to-vc4|VC4TileToVC4"),("producer",r"Triton|IREE|StableHLO|Torch|PyTorch|JAX|tt\.|ttir\.|stablehlo\.|linalg\."),("sub32",r"lower.*(f16|bf16|fp8|int8|uint8|int4|uint4)|pack.*(u8|i8|nibble)")]
bad=[]
for root in roots:
  if not root.exists(): continue
  for p in root.rglob("*"):
    if not p.is_file() or p.suffix not in {".td",".h",".cpp",".cc",".c",".py",".sh",".mlir"}: continue
    text=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
    for name,pat in checks:
      if re.search(pat,text,re.S): bad.append(f"{name}: {p}")
if bad:
  print("M5 anti-shortcut scan failed:")
  print("\n".join(bad[:200]))
  sys.exit(1)
print("m5-anti-shortcut-ok")
